## What he is looking for

## Experience

### Openbank (Grupo Santander) - Software Engineer - Jun 2025 to present
Digital bank, Germany market launch, Madrid.
- Java and Spring Boot services for the launch of Openbank in Germany; adapted the domain model and configuration to German regulatory requirements.
- Event-driven communication on AWS SQS, decoupling services and moving customer-onboarding work to asynchronous processing.
- Works in a large multi-team codebase, keeping architectural consistency across service boundaries.
- Built AI-assisted internal tooling (MCP server + agents) that lets engineers trace and diagnose onboarding flows end-to-end across microservices and logs.
- Stack: Java, Spring Boot, AWS SQS, CloudWatch, microservices.

### Paradigma Digital - Software Engineer - Oct 2021 to May 2025
Client: Simyo, the highest-rated telco app in Spain (4.8 Play Store / 4.7 App Store).
- Full revamp of the app backend, from architecture migration to performance optimization.
- Aggregation endpoints that removed redundant CRM calls: 2x faster responses.
- Led the migration from MVC to hexagonal architecture, so teams could evolve subsystems independently without breaking contracts.
- Observability from scratch: AOP-based instrumentation (Spring proxies) for logging and security monitoring feeding real-time anomaly detection in Kibana, plus Grafana dashboards and alerting that reduced mean time to detection.
- Stack: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Google Cloud, Grafana, Kibana.

### Experis (ManpowerGroup) - Software Engineer - Nov 2019 to Oct 2021
Clients: Banco Santander, Fira Barcelona (Mobile World Congress).
- Banco Santander: microservices bridging Spring Boot with legacy COBOL mainframe transactions, with circuit breakers (Hystrix) for fault tolerance under high concurrency.
- One of the first teams in the project to run automated E2E test suites (Selenium) in Jenkins CI/CD on every build.
- Mobile World Congress: COVID access-control services integrating third-party health-verification APIs under tight deadlines.
- Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Hystrix, DB2, Oracle, OpenShift, Jenkins.

### everis (NTT Data) - Software Engineer - Jun 2016 to Sep 2019
Client: Telefónica.
- Java and Spring Boot services for critical telecom infrastructure, in large codebases serving millions of users.
- SOAP and REST services for cross-system integrations.
- Introduced JUnit and SonarQube practices that reduced defect rates and became the team standard.
- Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Oracle, SonarQube, Jenkins.
